question: Who is the author of the book 'The Best Thing About You is You'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anupam Kher**__.

__
 
• **Anupam Kher wrote the book 'The best thing about you is you'**__.

 __
 
• The book was published in 2011.
 
• The idea behind the book is to inculcate positive thinking in daily life.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2011, Anupam Kher released his first book The Best Thing About You is You!, which was a best-seller.
 
 
• His biography **Lessons Life Taught Me Unknowingly** was published on 5 August 2019 by Penguin Random House.
 
• In 2020, he wrote **Your Best Day Is Today!, **based on his experiences of COVID-19 crisis.
